notes.title: OctoRaidVR_v1.3.1 BugFix&Patch
notes.content:
OctoRaidVR_v1.3.1 BugFix&Patch

Bug Fix of AI Gift Items
- When Hunter characters use it, there are issues with the use of items and shooting, so code is added to control the phenomenon
- Modifying the code because when the octo character is used, the octo is sometimes aimed at the octo character if there is no Hunter player target

Test the phenomenon control by adding the ability to automatically drop in relation to phenomena that can be thrown through the main map ceiling

Restore password functionality when creating a session

Add invincible status function for 15 seconds when the octo character is first created

Other balance adjustments are carried out
